headline: Android gets Mods and swipe-camera controls, while Vulkan gains FSR upscaling
summary: OpenRAC brings Mods, enhanced graphics and movable touch controls to Android, tested on an Ayn Odin 3 (OpenRAC#44). Enhanced Vulkan rendering gains FSR 3.1.4 temporal upscaling with no frame generation (OpenRAC#47), alongside rendering optimisations and Ratchet & Clank fixes for Gaspar, Orxon and save loading. Secret Agent Clank is added to the project, though the listed work does not establish playability (OpenRAC#45). Ratchet & Clank starts building NTSC-U within its own repository, Going Commando gains verified C switch-table linking, and Deadlocked adds three PAL-only functions. Keyboard & Mouse 1.2.3 completes a run of fixes for Quick Select crashes, map input and selecting menu-grid cells under the cursor.
